headline: No official burn specification has been published.
message: There is no official pECX burn address, redemption specification or conversion instruction yet. Redemption into ECX happens at mainnet (around 31 October 2026). Anything claiming otherwise — a "burn address" posted in a chat, a DM, or an unofficial site — should be treated as a scam until it appears on the official sources listed below.

expect.note: Balances may not carry over from alpha to beta.
